title: S1Arena-MM: Which Multimodal Decisions Can Be Left to System 1?
abstract: arXiv:2611.29773v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Perception systems often make discrete decisions: flag a hateful meme, predict whether a pedestrian will cross, detect a spoofed voice, or select the next move in a game. System-1 models, such as OneJev and Jev-Omni, read the media and return probabilities over the options in a single forward pass, while multimodal large language models (MLLMs) generate text. Which multimodal decisions can System-1 models handle, and where do MLLMs perform better? We introduce S1Arena-MM, a benchmark that gives every model the same decision requests and scores the probabilities it returns. It contains 51,060 questions across 94 tasks with image, video, and audio input, drawn from 94 public datasets and three program-generated ones. It also includes 102 closed-loop game environments that a model plays from screenshots; in real-time mode, the game continues while the model decides. translated_title: S1Arena-MM：哪些多模态决策可以交给系统1？
translated_abstract: 感知系统常常需要做出离散决策：标记仇恨表情包、预测行人是否会横穿马路、检测伪造语音、或在游戏中选择下一步动作。系统1模型（如OneJev和Jev-Omni）通过单次前向传播读取媒体内容并返回各选项的概率，而多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）则生成文本。哪些多模态决策可以由系统1模型处理，而MLLMs又在哪些场景下表现更好？我们提出了S1Arena-MM，这是一个基准测试，向每个模型提供相同的决策请求，并对其返回的概率进行评分。该基准包含51,060个问题，涵盖94个任务，涉及图像、视频和音频输入，数据来自94个公开数据集和三个程序生成的数据集。它还包括102个闭环游戏环境，模型根据截图进行游戏；在实时模式下，游戏在模型决策的同时持续进行。我们评估了33个开源模型，包括12个系统1模型和21个MLLMs。
tldr: 提出S1Arena-MM基准测试，通过51,060个跨94个任务的多模态问题及102个实时闭环游戏环境，系统比较系统1模型与多模态大语言模型在离散多模态决策上的表现，揭示二者各自擅长的决策场景。
en_tdlr: We introduce S1Arena-MM, a benchmark of 51,060 questions across 94 multimodal tasks and 102 closed-loop game environments that systematically compares System-1 models and MLLMs on discrete multimodal decisions, revealing which decisions each type of model can handle best.
